name: tokenshield-client-sdk
description: TokenShield client SDK + Lab Console — be the customer, see everything the gateway sends back.

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build -w @tokenshield/lab-server && npm run build -w @tokenshield/lab-web
scripts.dev: npm run build:client && concurrently -n client,server,web -c cyan,magenta,green "npm:dev:client" "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tokenshield/client && npm run typecheck -w @tokenshield/lab-server && npm run typecheck -w @tokenshield/lab-web
